content:
The console is the simplest way to tag a domain.
To create a tag (console)
1.
Go to https://aws.amazon.com, and then choose Sign In to the Console.
2.
Under Analytics, choose Amazon OpenSearch Service.
3.
Select the domain you want to add tags to and go to the Tags tab.
4.
Choose Manage and Add new tag.
Tagging examples
722
Amazon OpenSearch Service
Developer Guide
5.
Enter a tag key and an optional value.
6.
Choose Save.
To delete a tag, follow the same steps and choose Remove on the Manage tags page.
For more information about using the console to work with tags, see Tag Editor in the AWS
Management Console Getting Started Guide.
